pkgmetadata.longdescription: Meta-package depending on everything needed to build www-client/chromium of the same version (its DEPEND and BDEPEND), but not on Chromium itself. Useful to keep a build machine's toolchain in @world. Set the same USE flags as for www-client/chromium. Generated by scripts/gen-chromium-build-deps.py; the flag descriptions are Chromium's.

use.flag: Download and use the upstream binary toolchain(s) to build Chromium
Build Ozone only with headless backend, NOT RECOMMENDED for general use.
Enable Official build instead of Developer build.
Build with Profile Guided Optimizations (2-stage compilation)
Use system media-libs/harfbuzz instead of the bundled library.
Use system dev-libs/icu instead of the bundled one
Use system app-arch/zstd instead of the bundled one.
